Deepti once stayed until 2 a.m. to debug a cascading failure during a major ad campaign launch. When the billing system crashed mid-traffic, she methodically isolated the root cause—a misconfigured dependency between our real-time analytics and payment gateways—without escalating panic. Her calm, data-driven approach turned a potential $2M loss into a resolved issue by dawn. That incident cemented her reputation as someone who thrives under pressure and sees complexity as a puzzle to solve, not a barrier.  

Deepti is the backbone of our adtech operations, bridging engineering and product teams with relentless clarity. She doesn’t just troubleshoot systems—she anticipates how different components interact, especially in high-stakes scenarios like A/B testing or real-time bidding. Her knack for distilling technical jargon into actionable insights has made her indispensable in cross-functional meetings. Beyond her technical chops, she’s a mentor who quietly lifts others, whether by sharing debugging frameworks or advocating for documentation standards.  

What sets Deepti apart is her unshakable focus on reliability and her ability to balance urgency with precision. She’ll spend hours refining a process to prevent future outages, even if it means delaying a sprint. This diligence has minimized downtime during peak ad traffic periods, ensuring our clients’ campaigns run smoothly.  

Deepti’s blend of technical rigor and collaborative empathy makes her a rare asset. She’ll bring the same level of care to any role, turning challenges into opportunities for innovation. I wholeheartedly endorse her for positions requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on problem-solving.
